about: Vaccine fridge modelled as a generic product: white steel cabinet built as sides, back and head housing; glazed door of stiles and rails with gasket, hinges, lock and D-pull; control panel with display, temperature readout, alarm LED, keys and logger port; 5 wire baskets inside; machine compartment with vent slats on 4 feet. Water, drainage, gases and extract reach this item via the nested shared FMC_P_MechEq_ServicePoint (Medical Equipment cannot hold pipe or duct connectors). Reference: query: fridge vaccine medical equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=fridge+vaccine+medical+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
